teams8:
8-TEAM LEAGUE, PICK 7 (picks 7, 10, 23, 26, 39, 42, 55, 58, 71, 74, 87, 90, 103, 106, 119). Only 8 teams start players, so replacement level is HIGH: RB16/WR16/QB8/TE8 are your bench. Depth is nearly worthless; elite players and positional edges (an elite QB or TE) are worth more than in a 10/12-team league. You pick twice at the 7/10 turn, then wait 13 picks.
R1 #7 + R2 #10 (the turn): take the two best players available across RB/WR. Typical pair: one of Nacua/JSN/CMC/Achane at 7 plus one of Jefferson/St. Brown/Lamb/Saquon/Jeanty at 10. Prefer RB+WR; two RBs is fine if two tier-1 RBs are there.
R3 #23 + R4 #26: this turn still lands ADP 18-30 players. Best value here is often an elite TE (McBride/Bowers) or elite QB (Allen/Lamar/Daniels/Maye) because 8-team replacement at QB/TE is strong and the edge is big; pair with a tier-3 RB (Hampton/Irving/Kyren/Henderson/Chase Brown) or WR (Collins/London/BTJ/A.J. Brown/Pickens).
R5 #39 + R6 #42: fill the last starter slots (RB2/WR2/FLEX). Egbuka, McConkey, McMillan, Rice, Higgins, G. Wilson; RBs Judkins/Hall/Walker/Javonte/Etienne.
R7 #55 + R8 #58: QB if you do not have one (Burrow/Daniels tier or the round-8 group), TE if none (Warren/Fannin/Ferguson/Loveland), or the best upside RB/WR.
R9-R13 (#71-#106): pure upside and handcuffs only (your RB1's handcuff first). In an 8-team league waiver wire is deep, so chase ceiling, not floor: rookies with a path, ambiguous backfields, sophomore WRs.
R14 #106 / R15 #119: DEF then K (or K then DEF if the top defenses are gone). Never earlier.
Runs: with 8 teams, a run rarely empties a tier before your next pick; do not chase. Take the last elite QB/TE if the other one goes.
